citable.heading: What does “No MOQ” mean for a private-label IPL launch?
citable.body: “No MOQ” means you can start a branded IPL program with a smaller pilot quantity to validate your channel and messaging, then scale production through repeat orders instead of committing to large upfront inventory. A practical No MOQ setup includes clear branding requirements, defined packaging and manual content, stable bill of materials control, and a replenishment plan that supports predictable lead times as volume grows. The goal is to reduce launch risk while preserving a professional brand presentation.
